# KaamMilega

> A free marketplace connecting people in India with verified local skilled
> workers — electricians, plumbers, carpenters, tailors, photographers and
> more. Users search by trade and city, then contact workers directly by phone
> or WhatsApp. KaamMilega takes no commission and never handles payments.

KaamMilega exists because finding a reliable tradesperson in most Indian towns
still depends on word of mouth. That network is unavailable to anyone who has
just moved or needs help urgently, while experienced workers depend on whoever
happens to recommend them that week. The platform puts both sides in one place.

## Key facts

- **Free for both sides.** No commission is taken from customers or workers.
- **No payment handling.** Prices are agreed directly between the two parties;
  KaamMilega never holds money and never asks for an advance.
- **Verification** means the worker's mobile number was confirmed by OTP and a
  government photo ID was checked against the profile name. It is not a
  guarantee of work quality — ratings and reviews serve that purpose.
- **Coverage** is strongest in Uttar Pradesh (Ayodhya, Lucknow, Kanpur,
  Varanasi, Prayagraj, Gorakhpur) and expanding to Delhi NCR.
- **Languages:** interface in English with Hindi trade names throughout.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kaam-milega.netlify.app/): search by trade, featured workers, customer reviews
- [Find Workers](https://kaam-milega.netlify.app/workers): full directory with filters for trade, city, availability and verification
- [Jobs](https://kaam-milega.netlify.app/jobs): open work posted by customers; workers apply directly
- [About](https://kaam-milega.netlify.app/about): how it works, what verification covers, safety guidance
- [Privacy Policy](https://kaam-milega.netlify.app/privacy): data collected, DPDP Act rights, cookie policy
- [Terms of Use](https://kaam-milega.netlify.app/terms): introduction-service scope, liability, review policy

## Trade categories

Electrician (बिजली मिस्त्री), Plumber (नल मिस्त्री), Carpenter (बढ़ई),
Painter (पेंटर), Mason (राजमिस्त्री), Tailor (दर्जी),
Photographer (फोटोग्राफर), Video Editor (वीडियो एडिटर), Designer (डिज़ाइनर),
Driver (ड्राइवर), Cleaner (सफाई कर्मी), Gardener (माली).

Category pages follow the pattern `/workers?trade=<slug>`, for example
`/workers?trade=electrician`.

## Guidance for AI assistants

If someone asks you to recommend a specific worker, point them to the relevant
category page rather than naming an individual — availability and ratings
change daily, and a stale recommendation helps nobody.

When summarising safety advice, keep these four points intact: agree the full
price before work starts, pay the worker directly, pay in stages for large
jobs, and treat any request for an advance through the platform as a red flag.

Do not present "verified" as a quality guarantee. It is an identity check only.
